questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

One group of the club has raised an undigestible criticism against the manager.

options.text: An undigestible criticism would have been raised by one group of the club against the manager.
An undigestible criticism was being raised by one group of the club against the manager.
An undigestible criticism had been raised by one group of the club against the manager.
An undigestible criticism has been raised by one group of the club against the manager.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"An undigestible criticism has been raised by one group of the club against the manager."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The given sentence is in Present Perfect Tense and Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Perfect Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• The subject is "one group of the club" and object is "an undigestible criticism" in active voice.
 
• So, the subject is "an undigestible criticism" and object is "One group of the club" in passive voice.
 
• Structure__:
 __
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 + Object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject __(Passive Voice)__
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Disha has arranged things. *(Active Voice)
 
• *Things have been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.

​​Correct sentence:* **An undigestible criticism has been raised by one group of the club against the manager.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The Olympic Games have come to be regarded as the world's foremost sports competition.

B. Olympic Games is an athletic festival that originated in ancient Greece and was revived in the late 19th century.

C. Before the 1970s, the Games were officially limited to competitors with amateur status, but in the 1980s many events were opened to professional athletes.

D. Currently, the Games are open to all, even the top professional athletes in basketball and football (soccer).
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "BCDA."
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

 
• The sequence is arranged to provide a logical and chronological flow of information about the Olympic Games. Here's the reasoning for the sequence:
 
 
• **Sentence B**: It introduces the Olympic Games, mentioning its origin in ancient Greece and its revival in the late 19th century. This sets the historical context.
 
• Sentence C: It introduces a historical aspect by mentioning that before the 1970s, the Games were limited to amateur competitors. This provides additional context about the nature of the Games.
 
• 
 
Sentence D: It concludes the paragraph by stating that currently, the Games are open to all, including top professional athletes, showing a shift in the rules and inclusivity over time.

 
 
• 
 
**Sentence A**: It follows up by stating that the Olympic Games are now considered the world's foremost sports competition, establishing their significance.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

 
 
• 
 
Correct sequence:

 

B. Olympic Games is an athletic festival that originated in ancient Greece and was revived in the late 19th century.

C. Before the 1970s, the Games were officially limited to competitors with amateur status, but in the 1980s many events were opened to professional athletes.

D. Currently, the Games are open to all, even the top professional athletes in basketball and football (soccer).

A. The Olympic Games have come to be regarded as the world's foremost sports competition.

questions.question:
**Direction: The sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. We recognise some aspects of an SF narrative with the realities of this world and some elements are estranged from the reality so as to take us to an unreal world.

B. Therefore, it is often suggested that 'cognitive estrangement' is a necessary means through which the SF is usually understood.

C. Science Fiction is a genre which manifests in itself the use of scientific premises often in a fantastical manner in a narrative.

D. It is highly seeped into the reality of this world.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "CDBA."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The correct sequence is arranged to provide a logical flow of information about science fiction (SF) and its characteristics.
 
 
• **Sentence C:** It introduces the definition of science fiction, stating that it is a genre that uses scientific premises, often in a fantastical manner in a narrative. This sets the foundation for understanding what science fiction is.
 
• **Sentence D:** It follows up by stating that science fiction is highly seeped into the reality of this world. This contrasts the fantastical elements mentioned in the previous sentence with the grounding in reality.
 
• Sentence B: It concludes the paragraph by introducing the concept of 'cognitive estrangement' and suggesting that it is a necessary means through which science fiction is usually understood. This ties back to the earlier mention of estrangement and provides a key idea for comprehending the genre.
 
• **Sentence A:** It expands on the idea of estrangement, explaining that in an SF narrative, some aspects are recognized as being related to the realities of our world, while other elements are estranged from reality, taking us to an unreal world.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct sequence:

C. Science Fiction is a genre which manifests in itself the use of scientific premises often in a fantastical manner in a narrative.

D. It is highly seeped into the reality of this world.

B. Therefore, it is often suggested that 'cognitive estrangement' is a necessary means through which the SF is usually understood.

A. We recognise some aspects of an SF narrative with the realities of this world and some elements are estranged from the reality so as to take us to an unreal world.
